name: Guan Ju (關雎), the first ode of the Book of Songs
pages: Wikimedia Commons, "Guanju of GISHI GAKUFU 1768.jpg" (scan by Kato Toru, CC0)
about: The first ode of the Book of Songs, sung at the Zhou court: "Guan guan cry the ospreys, on the islet in the river." The Ming court song of the Wei family, printed in Japan in 1768, sets it with long melismas; a hand has written above the first page a plainer reading, one gongche note to each syllable, and that reading is followed here. Gongche: 合=C4, 四=D4, 上=F4, 尺=G4, 工=A4.
syllables: 關四 關工 雎尺 鳩上 | 在上 河尺 之四 洲尺 | 窈工 窕上 淑尺 女上 | 君上 子尺 好合 逑四
